campaign_owner.generation_convention: producer generation; root=0; issue sequence separate
campaign_owner.predecessor_binding: retained issuance ref/plan/count, not caller integer
campaign_owner.trust: configured local campaign host; no protected issuer/signing/global durability

successor_attacks.H1_ancestry_strip: PASS: retained lineage ref/ancestry; legacy canonical parent id now binds ancestry
successor_attacks.H2_generation_relabel: PASS: campaign derives generation from retained lineage; requested mismatch refuses
successor_attacks.H3_execution_binding: PASS: campaign reuses retained issuance/lineage; legacy execution rechecks embedded handoff refs
successor_attacks.H4_predecessor_undercount: PASS: campaign predecessor from retained head issuance/count; forged predecessor refuses
successor_attacks.H5_zero_cap: PASS: STOPPED_BUDGET + unissued, no native call
successor_attacks.H6_root_mismatch: PASS: campaign root fixed; legacy gen1 root predicate/source equality enforced

mutations_and_restoration.mutation: altered snapshot and recomputed internal hash
mutations_and_restoration.restored: original pinned snapshot restores and runs N+1

limits: Local trusted campaign authority only; no protected issuer/signing/R09/global anti-fork.
R03/U43/Batch, R04 custody, R05 grades, original 35/1890, F6/F7/F8, N11/N12, Sorok, production/CI, J52/W52 unchanged.
Restored old executions retain metadata but are not re-run; restored campaigns execute new N+1 work only.
Legacy issue/execute/activate helpers remain unqualified utilities and cannot register campaign history.
No self-adoption; fresh distinct reviewer required.
